description: Use this when the user asks about a company registered in France or Norway, or for the company registration number on a Kbis extract, for example "find the French company Danone", "who is behind SIREN 552032534?" or "look up Equinor in the Norwegian business register". Pass country FR or NO and the company name or its registration number (SIREN for France, organisation number for Norway). Returns the legal name, registration number, legal form, status (active, ceased, bankrupt, being wound up), registration date, registered address, activity code and, where published, size or employee count. Sole proprietors are left out. Do not use it for other countries, for owners, directors or any private person, or for accounts and credit ratings.

country.description: Register to search: FR (France, Sirene) or NO (Norway, Enhetsregisteret). Other countries are not covered.

query.description: Company name, or the registration number: SIREN (9 digits) for FR, organisation number (9 digits) for NO.

name: lookup_company_registry
title: Search a French SIREN or Norwegian register
